name: Stopping!!! 9: Natsu no Omoide Hen
original_name: ストッピング!!!9 夏の思い出編
source:
Is an animated novel in which a man with the ability to stop time does whatever he pleases to an unresisting girl. You will enjoy watching the girls who are enjoying their summer being defiled.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ140684.html/]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
这是一部动画小说，讲述了一个拥有让时间停止能力的男人对一个不反抗的女孩为所欲为的故事。你会喜欢看那些正在享受夏天的女孩被玷污的。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ140684.html/]Dlsite[/url]]
